films.title: STREET DRUGS
films.synopsis: BREAKING NEWS! Scientists at the University of Weedmount have discovered a brand new type of substance that will change the medical industry forever! Join Two Guys News, hosted by Bob and his co-anchor, Gareth Dingleberry, as they attempt to cover this new groundbreaking story.
films.funFact: This was an assignment for FILM 392.

films.title: STREET DRUGS 3
films.synopsis: Following the events of STREET DRUGS, Gareth Dingleberry awakens alone in the middle of a field and quickly rushes back to Two Guys News headquarters. Desperate to spread the word about the STREET DRUGS crisis, Gareth is baffled to discover that nobody else remembers it ever happening. Labelled as insane, he is forced into therapy, where he must confront the possibility that the crisis—and perhaps his own memories—may not be what they seem.
films.funFact: Currently in post-production. Aiming for a 2027 release date.

films.title: K-Town Noir
films.synopsis: A connoisseur of various drugs and substances, a local private investigator is tasked with solving a case that threatens to breach national security.
films.funFact: This was an assignment for FILM 392.

films.title: Shelter
films.synopsis: Realtor Jason Eade faces issues as a Canadian landlord.

films.title: The Bachelorette Party
films.synopsis: On the eve of her wedding, Aleeza and her bridesmaids gather for a night of drinks, laughter, and a classic game of dares—the King’s Game. But when Kyoko discovers a mysterious cross in their Airbnb, a dark curiosity awakens within the group. Faced with impossible choices and mounting terror, Aleeza must confront the horrifying reality that some games are never meant to be played.
films.funFact: This was an assignment for FILM 250, and got into the Kingston Film Festival!
